name: Business Advantage Unlimited Cash Rewards Mastercard® Credit Card

localized_names.en: Business Advantage Unlimited Cash Rewards Mastercard® Credit Card

apr.notes: APR not available from page text; page uses dynamic placeholders (ProdStanMinRate% to ProdStanMaxRate% Variable APR). See Bank of America for current APR.

fx_fee.notes: International transaction fee not stated on the product page.

base_rate.description: 1.5% cash back on all purchases. No annual cap and rewards don't expire as long as your account remains open.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem cash rewards as a deposit into eligible Bank of America checking or savings account, as a card statement credit, or as a check mailed to you. Preferred Rewards for Business members earn up to 75% more rewards (25% Gold, 50% Platinum, 75% Platinum Honors).

signup_bonus.description: Get a $500 cash rewards bonus after you make at least $5,000 in purchases within 90 days of your account opening.

benefits.title: No Annual Fee
benefits.description: Enjoy no annual fee while earning cash back.

benefits.title: Preferred Rewards for Business Bonus
benefits.description: Earn up to 75% more cash back with Preferred Rewards for Business. Platinum Honors members earn unlimited 2.62% cash back on all purchases with qualifying BofA business checking account.

benefits.title: Travel and Emergency Services
benefits.description: Travel services include auto rental coverage and $100,000 in travel accident insurance, auto rental insurance, emergency ticket replacement, lost luggage assistance and legal and medical referrals when away from home.

benefits.title: Employee Cards at No Additional Cost
benefits.description: Maintain a fleet of cards for your employees at no additional cost with ability to monitor all transactions.

benefits.title: Free Access to Business Credit Scores
benefits.description: View your Dun & Bradstreet business credit scores for free within Business Advantage 360.
